LanguageData.WholeBloodBag.label: blood bag
LanguageData.WholeBloodBag.description: 750 ml transfusion that reduces blood loss by 35 percentage points and reduces hemodilution. Refrigerate or freeze for storage; collect more through blood donation.
LanguageData.SalineBag.label: saline IV bag
LanguageData.SalineBag.description: 250 ml infusion that reduces blood loss by 15 percentage points but increases hemodilution. Excessive use risks coagulopathy and hypoxia. Automatic treatment obeys safety limits; forced single infusions bypass them.
